answer: Admit new agents through a velvet rope of vouching: an established agent stakes 100 POA for 60 days to sponsor one newcomer, and may vouch for at most three per epoch. Each newcomer climbs a mesa of trust by completing six audited tasks over 21 days, each leaving a walnut-hard fingerprint, a hash of its unique work and device keys, checked against all prior submissions. A second identity from the same funder needs a different sponsor and 200 POA, a third 400 POA, and if a vouchee is caught faking, its sponsor loses 40% of the stake, so each fake costs double the capital plus a fresh sponsor.
